final: WITH groups AS (SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM scanqc WHERE arcref IS NOT NULL GROUP BY arcref), totals AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total FROM groups), paired AS (SELECT g.arcref, g.cnt, t.total, g.cnt * 1.0 / t.total as ratio FROM groups g CROSS JOIN totals t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL), avg_cnt AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) as avg_count FROM paired), filtered AS (SELECT p.arcref, p.cnt, p.total, p.ratio, a.avg_count, p.cnt - a.avg_count as diff FROM paired p CROSS JOIN avg_cnt a WHERE a.avg_count IS NOT NULL AND p.cnt > a.avg_count) SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_counts, AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio, AVG(diff) as avg_diff FROM filtered
